about_short_description.short_description: AI-powered sales coach for B2B teams

product.name: SilkChart Playbook Adoption Analysis
product.description: Analyzes sales calls to measure and track how well sales playbooks are executed by individual reps and teams.

product.name: SilkChart AI Sales Coach
product.description: Provides AI-generated, specific, and actionable feedback to sales reps immediately after each call to improve sales conversations and playbook execution.

product.name: SilkChart Team Analytics
product.description: Automatically surfaces key calls and reps needing attention, provides alerts on churn risk, forecast risk, sentiment, and competitor mentions, and offers keyword analysis and customizable call summaries.

identifier.value: SilkChart Automated Call Recording and Transcription

product.name: SilkChart Automated Call Recording and Transcription
product.description: Automatically records and transcribes sales calls from platforms like Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams without requiring a bot to join the meeting.

product.name: SilkChart AI-Generated Post-Call Emails
product.description: Automatically drafts follow-up emails after sales calls using best practices to save time and maintain consistent communication.

product.name: SilkChart CRM and Workflow Integrations
product.description: Integrates with calendars, meeting platforms, Slack, email, and CRM systems to automate call recording, note-taking, and delivery of insights.
